changes.why: Three hard prerequisites gate skills their dependent KCs do not need: identifying a SPOF does not require availability arithmetic, defining WebSockets does not require polling, and the payment case's KCs do not use sagas. (critic f4: Move sd-single-points-of-failure → sd-availability-series-parallel and sd-case-payment-system → sd-sagas from requires to suggests. Move sd-websockets → sd-polling-long-polling to suggests and add a direct requires edge from sd-websockets to sd-http.)
